## Objective
- Make the existing Nightfall game playable on mobile devices.

## Requirements
- Build the requested change without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport no wider than 1280px) and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Adapt the existing Nightfall game rather than build a new game.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the project’s main game, markup, styles, and README.

### Active
- Implement mobile-friendly gameplay and verify it at a mobile viewport.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect mobile-specific input, layout, and touch handling in the existing code.
2. Make changes to support mobile controls and usable responsive layouts.
3. Run the game and check a mobile-sized screenshot against the requirements.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game markup and viewport configuration.
- `game.js`: Game logic and input handling.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layout and mobile styling.

## Important Context
- The game is “Nightfall — Keep Moving,” a dependency-free survival game.
- No changes have been made yet.
